title: CHAPTER 1: BASICS OF ECONOMICS
content:
👋 ሰላም ሰላም ውድ የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! እንደምን አላችሁ? ዛሬ ደግሞ ብዙዎቻችሁ በጉጉት ስትጠብቁት የነበረውን የFreshman Economics Course የመጀመሪያውን ክፍል (Chapter 1 - Part 1) ይዘንላችሁ መጥተናል።

ኧረ ለመሆኑ ኢኮኖሚክስ ሲባል አእምሯችሁ ውስጥ የሚመጣው ምንድን ነው? የወሩ መጨረሻ ላይ ኪስ ባዶ ሲሆን የሚደረገው ጥበብ ወይስ የሀገር ገንዘብ ጉዳይ? 😄 አትጨነቁ! በዚህ ክፍል Economics ምንድን ነው? የኢኮኖሚክስ 4ቱ ዋና ዋና ብያኔዎች (Wealth, Welfare, Scarcity & Growth)፣ Micro vs Macro፣ Positive vs Normative Analysis እንዲሁም Inductive vs Deductive Reasoning የሚሉትን መሰረታዊ ነጥቦች በስፋት፣ በጥልቀትና በፍፁም በማይሰለች መንገድ እንመለከታለን። ፈተና ላይ የሚደጋገሙ ነጥቦች ስላሉን ደብተራችሁንና እስክሪብቷችሁን ይዛችሁ ቁጭ በሉ! 👇👇👇

1.1 Definition of Economics

Economics is one of the most exciting and dynamic disciplines in social sciences. The word "economy" originates from the ancient Greek phrase "Oikonomia", which translates to "one who manages a household". At first glance, managing a household and managing an entire country's economy might seem completely different, but both fundamentally deal with the exact same challenge: allocating limited resources among competing needs!
👉 የቃሉ አመጣጥና ትርጉም: የኢኮኖሚክስ ቃል የመጣው "Oikonomia" ከሚለው የግሪክ ሀረግ ሲሆን ትርጉሙም "የቤት/የቤተሰብ አስተዳዳሪ" ማለት ነው። ድሮ በግሪክ ዘመን የቤት እመቤት ወይም አባት ያለው ገቢና ምግብ ለቤተሰቡ አባላት እንዴት አበቃቅሎ እንደሚያከፋፍል የሚያደርገው ጥረት፣ ዛሬ ሀገራት ውስን ሀብታቸውን ለህዝባቸው ከሚያከፋፉሉት መንገድ ጋር አንድ አይነት በመሆኑ ነው! (በነገራችን ላይ የወሩ መጨረሻ ላይ በ100 ብር ሳምንት የምታሳልፉ ተማሪዎች ትልቆቹ ኢኮኖሚስቶች እናንተ ናችሁ! 😂)

The science of economics in its modern and systematic form is about two hundred years old. Adam Smith – who is universally acknowledged as the father of economics – published his seminal book titled "An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of Wealth of Nations" in the historic year of 1776. While earlier philosophers and thinkers discussed basic economic concepts, it was Smith's treatise that formally established economics as an independent academic discipline.
👉 የኢኮኖሚክስ አባት (Father of Economics): አዳም ስሚዝ (Adam Smith) በ1776 እ.ኤ.አ "Wealth of Nations" የተባለውን ዝነኛ መጽሐፉን በማሳተም ኢኮኖሚክስ ራሱን የቻለ የትምህርት ዘርፍ እንዲሆን አስችሏል። ከዚያ በፊት ሰዎች ስለ ገንዘብ ያወሩ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሳይንሳዊ ቅርፅ የሰጠው አዳም ስሚዝ ነው።

Unlike natural sciences, there is no universally accepted single definition of economics. The definition remains controversial and dynamic because different theoretical schools of thought and economists have defined the subject from varying historical contexts and analytical perspectives. These perspectives are categorized into four major definitions:
👉 የኢኮኖሚክስ አራት ዋና ዋና ብያኔዎች (Four Definitions of Economics): ለኢኮኖሚክስ አንድ ወጥ ትርጉም የለውም። ኢኮኖሚስቶች ባሉበት ዘመንና እይታ መሰረት በ4 አበይት ክፍሎች ከፍለው ይበይኑታል፦

a. Wealth Definition (Adam Smith):
Classic economists led by Adam Smith defined economics purely as the "science of wealth". According to this view, economics studies how wealth is produced, consumed, exchanged, and distributed.
Critical limitation: It focused heavily on material wealth and completely ignored human welfare and moral values (critics mockingly called it the "dismal science").
👉 የሀብት ብያኔ (Wealth Definition): በአዳም ስሚዝ የሚመራው ይህ እይታ ኢኮኖሚክስ ማለት "ስለ ሀብት አመራረትና ስርጭት የሚያጠና ሳይንስ ነው" ይላል። ትኩረቱ በሙሉ ገንዘብና ቁሳቁስ ላይ በመሆኑ "የሰው ልጅ ደህንነት የት ገባ?" ተብሎ በወቅቱ ክፉኛ ተነቅፏል።

b. Welfare Definition (Alfred Marshall):
In 1890, Alfred Marshall shifted the emphasis from wealth to human well-being in his book "Principles of Economics". He defined economics as "a study of mankind in the ordinary business of life". He argued that wealth is not an end in itself, but merely a means to achieve human material welfare.
👉 የደህንነት/መልካም ህይወት ብያኔ (Welfare Definition): አልፍሬድ ማርሻል የተባለው ኢኮኖሚስት ሀብት በራሱ ግብ ሳይሆን የሰውን ልጅ ህይወት ለማሻሻያ የሚረዳ መሳሪያ ነው በማለት ኢኮኖሚክስ "ስለ የሰው ልጅ ቁሳዊ ደህንነትና መልካም ህይወት ያጠናል።" ብሎ አሻሽሎታል።

c. Scarcity Definition (Lionel Robbins):
In 1932, Lionel Robbins provided the most dominant and analytical definition in his book "An Essay on the Nature and Significance of Economic Science". He defined economics as: "the science which studies human behavior as a relationship between ends and scarce means which have alternative uses." This definition introduced three crucial elements: Unlimited Ends (wants), Scarce Means (resources), and Alternative Uses.
👉 የእጥረት ብያኔ (Scarcity Definition): ላይኦነል ሮቢንስ የተባለው ኢኮኖሚስት ያቀረበውና ዛሬ ድረስ ተቀባይነት ያለው ትርጉም ሲሆን፣ ኢኮኖሚክስ ማለት፦ "ያልተገደበ የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎትን (Ends) እና ለተለያዩ ነገሮች ሊውሉ የሚችሉ ውስን ሀብቶችን (Scarce Means) አጣጥሞ የመጠቀም የሰው ልጅ ባህሪ ያጠናል" ብሏል።

d. Growth Definition (Paul Samuelson):
Modern economist Paul Samuelson expanded Robbins' definition by adding a dynamic and time-dimension aspect. He defined economics as the study of how societies use scarce resources to produce valuable commodities and distribute them among different people over time, considering technological progress and economic growth.
👉 የዕድገት ብያኔ (Growth Definition): ፖል ሳሙኤልሰን ደግሞ የሮቢንስን ሀሳብ በመውሰድ የጊዜና የዕድገት (Time & Growth) ሁነቶችን አክሎበታል። ሀብት ዛሬ ብቻ ሳይሆን ወደፊት እንዴት እንደሚያድግና ለወደፊት ትውልድ እንደሚከፋፈል ያጠናል ብሏል።

Formal and Commonly Accepted Definition:
Combining these theoretical developments, modern text consensus defines economics as follows:

Economics is a social science that studies the efficient allocation of scarce resources in order to attain the maximum possible fulfillment of unlimited human material needs and wants. As a science of choice, it analyzes how individuals, businesses, and governments make decisions to utilize limited productive factors (land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurship).
👉 ይፋዊና ዘመናዊ ትርጉም (Formal Definition): ባጭሩ ኢኮኖሚክስ ማለት የማህበራዊ ሳይንስ ዘርፍ ሲሆን፣ የሚያጠናውም ውስን ሀብቶችን (Scarce resources) በብቃት እና በጥበብ (Efficient allocation) በመጠቀም ያልተገደቡ የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎቶችን (Unlimited human needs) እስከ ከፍተኛው ደረጃ እንዴት ማሟላት እንደምንችል ነው።

The core principles extracted from this formal definition include:
• Resources are fundamentally scarce. (ሀብቶች በተፈጥሯቸው ውስን ናቸው)
• Resources must be allocated across competing priorities. (ሀብት በቅድሚያ ተለይቶ መመደብ አለበት)
• Resource utilization must be efficient without wastage. (ክፍፍሉ ያለብክነት ውጤታማ መሆን አለበት)
• Human needs and desires are unlimited and insatiable. (የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎት በጭራሽ የማያልቅና አላስቆም የሚል ነው)
• The ultimate goal is to maximize societal satisfaction and welfare.
👉 ዋና አላማ: አነስተኛዋን ሀብት አበቃቅሎ በመጠቀም ከፍተኛ እርካታና ጥቅም ማግኘት ነው! (ለምሳሌ፡ በ10 ብር ካፌ ገብቶ ካፑቺኖ፣ ኬክ እና ሰላምታ አብሮ የመጠበቅ ያህል ማለት ነው! 😜)

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ የ 4ቱን ኢኮኖሚስቶች ብያኔ Match አድርጉ ተብሎ ይመጣል። Adam Smith = Wealth፣ Alfred Marshall = Welfare፣ Lionel Robbins = Scarcity፣ Paul Samuelson = Growth አድርጋችሁ በጥንድ ያዙአቸው!


1.2 The Rationales of Economics

Why do we study economics? There are two fundamental facts that form the absolute foundation for the entire subject of economics:
1) Human (society's) material wants are virtually unlimited and ever-expanding.
2) Economic resources available to satisfy these wants are strictly limited (scarce).
👉 ሁለቱ ዋና መነሻዎች (Fundamental Facts): 1) የሰው ልጅ ፍላጎት ያልተገደበ (Unlimited) መሆኑ — ዛሬ Button ስልክ ሲኖረን ስማርትፎን፣ ስማርትፎን ሲኖረን ላፕቶፕ፣ ላፕቶፕ ሲኖረን መኪና እንመኛለን፤ ፍላጎት አያልቅም! 2) ፍላጎታችንን ለማሟላት የሚያስፈልጉት ሀብቶች ደግሞ ውስን (Scarce) መሆናቸው ናቸው።

The collision between these two inescapable facts gives birth to the basic economic problem: Scarcity and Choice. Because we cannot have everything we want due to resource constraints, we are forced to choose between alternatives. Therefore, economics is often described as the "Science of Choice". Every choice involves a trade-off—giving up one thing to get another.
👉 መሰረታዊ የኢኮኖሚ ችግር (Basic Economic Problem): የኢኮኖሚክስ እውነተኛው ስር መሰረት Scarcity (እጥረት) እና Choice (ምርጫ) ነው። ሀብታችን ውስን በመሆኑ ሁሉንም ማግኘት አንችልም። ስለዚህ አንዱን ለማግኘት ሌላውን የመተው (Trade-off) ምርጫ ለማድረግ እንገደዳለን።

At all levels—whether as individual consumers deciding how to spend monthly pocket money, families budgeting for housing, or national governments allocating budgets between national defense and public healthcare—we constantly face difficult economic decisions. Economists systematically evaluate how these decisions are made and assess results using three primary criteria: Efficiency (maximizing output), Equity (fairness in distribution), and Stability (minimizing economic shocks).
👉 የውሳኔዎች ሚና: ግለሰቦች፣ ቤተሰቦችና ሀገራት የሚያደርጓቸው ምርጫዎች ውጤታማ (Efficiency)፣ ፍትሃዊ (Equity) እና የተረጋጉ (Stability) መሆናቸውን ኢኮኖሚስቶች ይመረምራሉ።


1.3 Scope and Method of Analysis in Economics

The scope of economics has expanded dramatically to address modern complexities (giving rise to sub-fields like Environmental Economics, Behavioral Economics, Development Economics, and Financial Economics). However, the foundational method of economic analysis splits the field into two broad branches: Microeconomics and Macroeconomics.
👉 የኢኮኖሚክስ ወሰን: ኢኮኖሚክስ በውስጡ ብዙ ንኡሳን ዘርፎች ቢኖሩትም፣ የዘመናዊ ኢኮኖሚክስ ሁለቱ ዋና ዋና ምሰሶዎች Microeconomics እና Macroeconomics ናቸው።

1.3.1 Scope of Economics

A. Microeconomics (derived from the Greek word "Mikros" meaning small) focuses on the economic behavior and decision-making of individual units within the economy, such as a single consumer, a single household, a single business firm, or a specific market for a particular good.
👉 Microeconomics (ማይክሮ-ኢኮኖሚክስ): በትንሹ ደረጃ ያሉትን ነጠላ ክፍሎች ያጠናል። ስለ አንድ ተማሪ የወጪ ውሳኔ፣ ስለ አንድ ሱቅ ትርፍ ወይም ስለ አንድ ፋብሪካ ምርት የሚያጠና የኢኮኖሚክስ ዘርፍ ነው።

B. Macroeconomics (derived from the Greek word "Makros" meaning large) examines the structure, performance, and behavior of the economy as a whole. It studies aggregate variables and country-wide issues such as total national output, general inflation, national unemployment rates, trade balances, and monetary policies.
👉 Macroeconomics (ማክሮ-ኢኮኖሚክስ): የሀገርን አጠቃላይ ኢኮኖሚ በሰፊው የሚመለከት ነው። ስለ ሀገራዊ ገቢ (GDP)፣ ስለ ስራ አጥነት፣ ስለ አጠቃላይ የዋጋ ንረት (Inflation) እና ስለ ሀገራት የንግድ ልውውጥ ያጠናል።

Microeconomics Summary
• Studies individual economic units and decision-makers. (ነጠላ የኢኮኖሚ ክፍሎችን ያጠናል)
• Focuses on individual income, specific product price, individual firm output. (ስለ አንድ ግለሰብ ገቢ፣ ስለ አንድ እቃ ዋጋና ምርት ያጠናል)
• Central problem: Price determination and optimal resource allocation. (ዋና ትኩረቱ የዋጋ አወሳሰንና የሀብት ክፍፍል ነው)
• Main tools: Demand and Supply of specific goods. (ዋና መሳሪያዎቹ የነጠላ እቃዎች Demand እና Supply ናቸው)
• Examples: Price of teff in Merkato, individual salary, profit of a specific coffee shop.
Macroeconomics Summary
• Studies the overall economy and aggregate indicators. (ሀገራዊ አጠቃላይ ኢኮኖሚን ያጠናል)
• Focuses on Aggregate Output, National Income, General Price Level. (ስለ ሀገራዊ ገቢ፣ ምርት እና አጠቃላይ የዋጋ ደረጃ ያጠናል)
• Central problem: Determination of national income, growth, and employment levels. (ዋና ትኩረቱ ሀገራዊ ዕድገትና የስራ እድል ፈጠራ ነው)
• Main tools: Aggregate Demand (AD) and Aggregate Supply (AS). (ዋና መሳሪያዎቹ Aggregate Demand እና Aggregate Supply ናቸው)
• Examples: Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Ethiopia's inflation rate, national unemployment level.

Note: Microeconomics and Macroeconomics are not mutually exclusive; they are highly complementary. Macroeconomic trends are ultimately the result of millions of microeconomic individual choices!
👉 ተሟላጭነት (Complementary): ማይክሮ እና ማክሮ አይጣሉም፤ አንዱ የሌላው መሰረት ነው። የሀገር አጠቃላይ ኢኮኖሚ (Macro) የሚገነባው የግለሰቦችና የድርጅቶች (Micro) ውሳኔ ተደምሮ ነው።

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ጥያቄዎች ላይ "Price of a single commodity" ካላችሁ Micro ነው፤ "General Price Level / Inflation" ካላችሁ ደግሞ Macro ነው። ቃላቶቹን በጥንቃቄ ለዩ! (ሰንጠረዡ በስልክ ስክሪን እንዲመች በጥንቃቄ ተዘጋጅቷል)።


1.3.2 Positive and Normative Analysis

Is economics an objective factual science (Positive) or a value-based judgmental study (Normative)? The answer is: It incorporates both!

Positive Economics: Focuses on objective analysis, facts, and cause-and-effect relationships. It describes the economic world as it actually is, answering questions like "What was?", "What is?", or "What will be?" Crucially, positive statements can be tested, verified, or refuted by checking empirical data and facts. They contain no value judgments.
👉 Positive Economics (ሐቅ ተኮር): ያለውን ነባራዊ እውነታ ብቻ ይገልጻል (What is / What will be)። ምንም አይነት የግል አስተያየት የለበትም። መረጃ ወይም Data በመመልከት እውነት ወይም ሐሰት መሆኑን ማረጋገጥ ይቻላል።

Examples of Positive Statements:
• The current annual inflation rate in Ethiopia exceeds 20 percent.
• Increasing the tax on cigarettes will reduce smoking frequency among youths.
• Unconditional cash transfers increase household consumption levels.
(All these statements deal with testable real-world facts—whether true or false!).

Normative Economics: Incorporates subjective value judgments, ethics, and opinions about what the economy ought to be like. It addresses questions such as "What ought to be?" or "What should be done?" Normative statements express ideological preferences and policy recommendations. Because they are based on personal values rather than objective data, they cannot be proven or disproven by referencing facts.
👉 Normative Economics (አስተያየት ተኮር): "ምን መሆን አለበት?" (What ought to be / Should be) ለሚለው ጥያቄ የግል እሴትንና አስተያየት (Value judgment) በመጨመር የሚሰጥ ሀሳብ ነው። በዳታ ማረጋገጥ አይቻልም፤ ሰው እና ሰው በሀሳብ ሊለያይ ይችላል። የሚወሰነውም በድምፅ አሰጣጥ (Voting) ወይም በፖሊሲ ውሳኔ ነው።

Examples of Normative Statements:
• The government should provide free university education for all freshmen.
• High-income earners ought to be taxed at a much higher rate to reduce inequality.
• Unemployment benefits must be prioritized over infrastructure spending.

💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ላይ አረፍተ ነገር ተሰጥቷችሁ ለዩ ከተባላችሁ፦ "should", "ought to", "must", "desirable" የሚሉ የሞራል/የአስተያየት ቃላት ካሉበት Normative ነው! ንጹህ መረጃና አሃዝ ብቻ የያዘ ከሆነ Positive ነው።


1.3.3 Inductive and Deductive Reasoning in Economics

To build valid generalizations and scientific theories about economic behavior, economists use logical reasoning. A theory is a simplified representation of reality used to understand complex economic phenomena. The two fundamental methods of logical reasoning are Inductive and Deductive reasoning.
👉 የምክንያታዊነት አስፈላጊነት: ኢኮኖሚስቶች የሰዎችን ባህሪና የገበያን ሁኔታ አጥንተው አጠቃላይ ቲዎሪ (Laws/Theories) ለማውጣት ሁለት አይነት አዎንታዊ መንገዶችን ይጠቀማሉ።

a) Inductive Reasoning (Empirical Method):
This method derives general theories and principles from specific observed facts and data. It moves from particular to general or from facts to theory. Economists observe economic trends in real life, collect historical data, analyze patterns, and then formulate a generalized economic rule.
👉 Inductive Reasoning (ከነጠላ ወደ አጠቃላይ): ከተበታተኑ እውነታዎችና መረጃዎች ተነስተን ወደ አጠቃላይ ቲዎሪ መድረስ ነው (Particular to General / Facts → Theory)። ለምሳሌ፦ የ10 ሰዎችን የገበያ ግዢ ሁኔታ በቅርበት ተከታትሎ አይቶ "የእቃ ዋጋ ሲጨምር ሰዎች ግዢ ይቀንሳሉ" የሚል አጠቃላይ ህግ ማውጣት ማለት ነው።

Core Steps in Inductive Approach:
1. Identifying the economic problem.
2. Collecting, classifying, and statistically analyzing empirical data.
3. Establishing cause-and-effect relationships to draw a general conclusion.

b) Deductive Reasoning (Analytical/Abstract Method):
This method starts with an established general statement, fundamental truth, or basic assumption (axiom) and derives specific conclusions through logical deduction. It moves from general to particular or from theory to facts. Once the hypothesis is derived theoretically, it is tested against real-world facts.
👉 Deductive Reasoning (ከአጠቃላይ ወደ ነጠላ): ከአጠቃላይ ህግ ወይም ቲዎሪ ተነስተን ወደ ነጠላ እውነታዎች መውረድ ነው (General to Particular / Theory → Facts)። ለምሳሌ፦ "ሰዎች ሁልጊዜ አነስተኛ ዋጋ ይፈልጋሉ" ከሚል አጠቃላይ ህግ ተነስተን "ስለዚህ አበበ ዋጋ ሲወርድ ይገዛል" ብሎ መደምደም።

Core Steps in Deductive Approach:
1. Defining the economic problem.
2. Formulating basic assumptions/axioms.
3. Constructing hypotheses through formal logic.
4. Testing the validity of hypotheses against empirical evidence.

💡 Exam Hint: ይህቺ አጭር የቀመር ቀመር በጭንቅላታችሁ ያዙአት፦
• Inductive = Particular → General (Facts to Theory)
• Deductive = General → Particular (Theory to Facts)
